technology.value: A nylon-sphere vessel of pseudocumene+PPO liquid scintillator viewed by photomultiplier tubes, surrounded by buffer liquid and a water-Cherenkov muon veto
technology.quote: The scintillator is pseudocumene and PPO which is held in place by a thin nylon sphere.

summary.plain: A nylon sphere full of ultra-pure liquid, watched by photomultiplier tubes, that catches the faint flashes of light neutrinos leave behind as they pass through.
summary.technical: Liquid-scintillator (pseudocumene+PPO) detector, 278 t active mass, ~100 t fiducial mass, in a nylon vessel with a water-Cherenkov muon veto; operated at LNGS Hall C from May 2007 to October 2021.
